messages:
alex.k: Quick check — we're short ~8 A100s in us-east4 for the inference benchmark tomorrow morning. Can anyone confirm vendor ETA or a feasible borrow from standby?

maria.p: Oof, timeline tight. Did we already request an upsize from vendor last week? Ticket #4742 shows 'pending'.

prashant: I opened a small PR to add a temporary dedicated pool patch (refs: https://git/repo/pulls/321). If we can get quota, terraform apply should spin them up in ~12m.

alex.k: Nice. PR LGTM-ish but need someone to approve infra/networking bits. @prashant can you add the minimal IGW rule change in the same PR?

prashant: Yep will add. Putting the terraform snippet here for quick review:

```
# modules/dedicated_pool/main.tf (snippet)
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "shortterm_a100" {
  region       = "us-east4"
  gpu_type     = "A100"
  count        = 8
  burst_policy = "on_demand"
}
```

maria.p: Also check project quota limit — I remember we hit a per-project GPU SKU cap last quarter. Alex, which project are you planning to use?

alex.k: Trying to use infra-dev-ai (project id: redwood-infra-dev). If quota blocked, fallback is demo-standby pool but that would affect a demo at 11am.

vendor-ops-bot: Vendor update: Rack shipment delayed by 18 hrs due to customs hold. ETA window now 2026-03-22 18:00-23:00 UTC. Channel: #vendor-notify.

alex.k: Thanks — that rules out new hardware. Can we do quota bump from cloud provider for infra-dev-ai? Who owns that request?

maria.p: I can file the quota request right now. Will need the exact SKU and region: compute.googleapis.com/A100_US_EAST4 and reason (bench + smoke for canary).

alex.k: Perfect — please include expected start time: 2026-03-22T05:00Z and duration ~6 hours. Also cc finance for short-term charge approval.

maria.p: Filed request: https://cloud.console/quotas/request/req-9981 — status PENDING. I added note: 'bench + canary; fallback to demo pool unacceptable'.

prashant: Meanwhile I'll add a conditional in the PR to fallback to demo-standby pool if quota request denied, plus a knob to reduce count to 4 for a quick smoke.

alex.k: Good. If quota arrives, can someone trigger the CI job that runs the infra apply? @ci-bot can you run pipeline infra/deploy-shortbench when PR merged? :eyes:

ci-bot: Trigger received. I will run infra/deploy-shortbench after merge and report status in this thread.

maria.p: FYI finance ok'd up to ~$3k for emergency weekend burst — I cc'd trevor.

alex.k: Thank you all. Plan summary: 1) maria files quota (done), 2) prashant updates PR with fallback knob (in progress), 3) pr merges and ci-bot runs deploy, 4) if quota stays pending, we fallback to demo-standby with reduced capacity. I'll post final status by 04:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

prashant: Added fallback flag and reduced-count option, pushed to PR 321. Marked reviewers: @maria.p.

maria.p: Reviewing now. Small comment on naming convention but nothing blocking.

alex.k: Great — closing loop. If vendor updates change, vendor-ops-bot please ping here.

vendor-ops-bot: Will do. Automated ETA monitor enabled for this shipment.
